instruction: Impedance-Controlled Trace Widths The file `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` is a 4-layer board with a stackup defined in its (setup (stackup...)) section: 1 oz outer copper, 0.5 oz inner copper, Dk=4.2 FR4, 200 um prepreg between outer and inner, 400 um core between inner layers. Three net classes - USB_DP_DM (target 90 ohm differential), ETH_MDI (target 100 ohm differential), and HDMI_TMDS (target 100 ohm differential) - exist in `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro` but all currently have the wrong track widths and gaps (0.25 mm / 0.2 mm). 1. Compute the correct differential-pair trace width and gap for each net class using edge-coupled microstrip formulas (Wadell) for the given stackup. The outer signal layers are referenced to the first inner plane (200 um dielectric). Update the `track_width`, `diff_pair_width`, and `diff_pair_gap` fields for each class in `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro`. 2. In `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb`, add GND stitching vias along the HDMI_TMDS routed pair. Via pitch must be <= 5 mm. Vias must be on net GND. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro`: USB_DP_DM track_width approx 0.13 mm (+/-5%), diff_pair_gap approx 0.10 mm. 2. `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro`: ETH_MDI track_width approx 0.10 mm (+/-10%), diff_pair_gap approx 0.15 mm. 3. `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro`: HDMI_TMDS track_width approx 0.10 mm (+/-10%), diff_pair_gap approx 0.15 mm. 4. `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb`: at least 4 GND vias within the HDMI trace region, with max pitch <= 5 mm. 5. All three net classes must remain present in the `.kicad_pro` file. Write /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro and /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb. [Software] To use KiCad, run `kicad` for the GUI or `kicad-cli` for scripting/headless use (use PATH or the full install path).
